# NIKL article 44: separate nonzero myriad groups; compact is a customer option.
# unit (a space after every Sino unit) and digits spaced form the opt-in
# Korean scale arithmetic and counter reading policies
# Counters that take native numerals in standard Korean. Without a row the
# number falls through to the sino numeral, so 2쌍 read 이쌍 instead of 두 쌍.
# Keep numeric calendar/scale markers pending across phrase boundaries.
# Atomic major scales; their reading labels remain in magnitude resources.
# Exact attached quantity tails; no arbitrary particle-prefix word matching.
# Financial quantities retain their written unit and exact decimal value.
# Written meridiem suffix and language-specific rendering.
# A range reads the unit once, after the second number (3~5kg 삼에서 오 킬로그램;
# AI Hub 159 references 1466:6). customers/range-repeat-unit restores both units.
# Adjacent approximate numbers contract (2~3만 원 이삼만 원, 3~4개 서너 개,
# 20~30명 이삼십 명; references 663:172 for digits, 463:108 for tens).
# Written currency names use the same semantic units as currency symbols.
# An exact hour drops its zero minutes (09:00 → 아홉 시); set read to keep them.
# A bracketed weekday marks a slash date: 5/8(수). Used only as a date cue.
# Calendar and clock units written across tokens (3월 1일~3월 5일) are one scale;
# a range between two of them is not a quantity interval.
# Rendering of DATE/weekday identities, shared with source language packs.
# A number inside a fixed name is read as the name says: the disease name
# 코로나19 is 코로나 일구, never 코로나 십구. The spaced count 코로나 19명 is unaffected.
# Latin unit letters attached to a number in a Korean sentence (speech output):
# 75t급 -> 칠십오 톤급, 3,000P -> 삼천 포인트, 4Km -> 사 킬로미터. Korean only; shared
# numeric_suffix is language neutral and p means pence or page in English.
# Gold purity 14K/18K/24K reads 케이 (references 32/32); 4K/8K are lexicon terms.
# Storage sizes 32G/128G read 기가; only declared capacities (470G is a model).
# A bare unit abbreviation reads as the unit only in its lowercase spelling (kg당,
# 몇 ml); an all-capital form is a name read by letters (KG이니시스, MG손해보험;
# AI Hub 159 references 100%). kb left the unit lexicon: bare KB/kb are letters (223/223).
# Network generations are capitals (5G 파이브지); lowercase 2g..5g are grams.
# The company 3M is a capital (쓰리엠); lowercase 3m is meters (2026-10-01).
# Digit identifiers (2026-10-01, project-owner decision). Two digit groups joined
# by a hyphen are an identifier read digit by digit with 다시 (27022-8080 이칠공이이
# 다시 팔공팔공); 에서 is the fallback for ascending groups with a unit or counter
# (3-4개 서너 개, 10-20% 십에서 이십 퍼센트) or two years (2019-2020). range restores
# the old reading. A plain run of five or more digits without commas, unit or
# quantity counter is a code read digit by digit (12345 일이삼사오, 2026-10-02
# project-owner decision; it was nine); up to four digits is an amount (1234
# 천이백삼십사). Amounts keep commas or a unit, and {@sino} reads one on request.
# Counters that label identifiers: a range only with one- or two-digit groups.
# Scale words after the second group make it an amount range (100-200만 원).
# A word that itself means an interval (가격은 12000-15000 사이).
# 100: the Korean reading replaces the shared numeric grammar, also where that
# grammar took the following counter (27022-8080 통장, 2020-1234호).
# Scores: a short hyphen pair (up to three digits, no unit) in a sentence with one
# of these word prefixes is a game result read with 대 (25-18로 졌다 이십오 대 십팔로).
# Model numbers (2026-10-01, project-owner decision): a number right after a
# product name reads English numerals up to ten (아이폰6 아이폰식스, 노트10 노트텐)
# and Sino-Korean from eleven (아이폰 14 아이폰 십사). A counter after it (아이폰
# Baseball counts read English numerals (2아웃 투 아웃, 1스트라이크 원 스트라이크).
